task.description:
Run the EE-07 test suite and produce a structured test report.

1. Run: `zig build test` — collect full output.
2. If integration tests are available for EE-07, run: `zig build test-integration` (requires BPM_TEST_DB_URL).
3. Write the test report to `tests/reports/WF02-ee07-20260522-test-run.json` in the standard format (see tests/reports/ for examples).

The report MUST include:
- run_id, requirement_id, timestamp
- Per-test-case results: test_id, status (PASS/FAIL), error_message (if FAIL)
- Overall: total, passed, failed
- result.status: PASS if all tests pass, FAIL otherwise
- result.issues: list of failing test case IDs with error summaries (empty list if all pass)

If any tests fail, set result.status = FAIL and populate result.issues. Do NOT attempt to fix failing tests — that is ISSUE-FIXER's job.
acceptance_criteria: All EE-07 unit test cases have PASS status in the report

result.summary: All 5 EE-07 unit test cases passed. zig build test exited 0. TC-EE-07-01 through TC-EE-07-04 confirmed in src/engine/transition.zig; TC-EE-07-05 confirmed in tests/unit/test_ee07_parallel_join.zig.
